summary: Comprehensive testing of Shift Management feature. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified: workspace detail page with Shifts button, Shift Management page with calendar view, summary cards, shift creation dialog, and successful shift creation with toast notification.
passed_tests: BACKEND API TESTS (18/18 passed):
- GET /api/health returns healthy status
- POST /api/shifts/create creates shift successfully with all fields
- POST /api/shifts/create calculates hours correctly (8.5h for 08:00-16:30)
- GET /api/shifts/workspace/{workspace_id} returns shifts with users and total
- GET /api/shifts/workspace/{workspace_id} with date filters works correctly
- GET /api/shifts/{shift_id} returns single shift
- PUT /api/shifts/{shift_id} updates shift and persists changes
- DELETE /api/shifts/{shift_id} removes shift and returns 404 on subsequent GET
- POST /api/shifts/{shift_id}/duplicate creates copy with new date
- GET /api/shifts/summary/{workspace_id} returns dashboard data
- GET /api/shifts/swap-requests/{workspace_id} returns swap requests
- GET /api/shifts/time-off/{workspace_id} returns time off requests
- GET /api/shifts/export/{workspace_id}?format=json returns JSON file
- GET /api/shifts/export/{workspace_id}?format=csv returns CSV file
- GET /api/shifts/roles/{workspace_id} returns unique roles
- GET /api/shifts/departments/{workspace_id} returns unique departments
- GET /api/shifts/nonexistent-id returns 404
- PUT /api/shifts/nonexistent-id returns 404
FRONTEND UI TESTS:
- Login page loads and authentication works
- Workspaces page shows workspace cards with Manage button
- Workspace detail page (/workspace/{id}/manage) shows Shifts button with data-testid='shifts-btn'
- Workspace overview shows Shift Management card with data-testid='shifts-overview-card'
- Shift Management page (/workspace/{id}/shifts) loads with data-testid='shift-management-page'
- Summary cards display: Today's Shifts, Week Total Hours, Active Team, Pending Requests
- Calendar view displays March 2026 with day cells and navigation
- Create Shift button opens dialog
- Create Shift dialog contains: Date, Assign To, Start Time, End Time, Role, Department, Color selector, Notes, Recurring checkbox
- Shift creation via UI works - success toast shown, shift appears on calendar
- Calendar shows shift badge on date with count indicator
- Week Total Hours updates after shift creation (0h -> 8h)
- Shifts and Requests tabs present in UI
